text:
amaia (AE): FYI Hightower Finance asked for a SOC 2 artifact bundle + signed pen-test letter for the POC. They want it before next Wed to close. Also asking if Dedicated/Single-tenant increases the POC quote. TL;DR: evidence + signer + pricing uplift?
raj (SalesEng): can we confirm scope? SOC 2 extracts (control matrix + system description) + report excerpts or full infra diagrams? do they need on-prem/network diagrams too?
marta (Security): we can provide SOC 2 Type II excerpt (security + availability) and an ISO summary. For pen-test we need to confirm signer: internal PD or third-party lead? we can issue a pen-test attestation letter template but signing requires C-level or delegated security contact. cc @ellie for signer name routing. :memo:
ellie (SalesOps): Pricing: POC on hosted = no uplift. Dedicated (reserved pool) = base reserved fee + per-GPU hour. Example calc: `monthly = base_lease + (gpu_hours * gpu_rate)`. If they want a one-week dedicated burst we can quote a short-term commit; I'll pull numbers.
sam (Support): we can upload requested artifacts to a presigned ZIP. I can run the upload and share a link. For network diagrams we redact customer-identifiable samples unless they request full diagrams in an NDA dataroom.
amaia (amaia typo correction): oops meant amaia.
dataroom-bot: New evidence bundle created: rwd-evidence-17645.zip (expires in 7 days). link: https://dataroom.internal/rwd-evidence-17645.zip
raj (SalesEng): for the pen-test signer, if they need a 3rd-party sign-off we can provide the vendor-contact we used for last year's external scan: contact@red-audit.io (they give a standard letter). If Hightower wants our internal attestation -> need security lead sign-off and date.
marta (Security): can someone collect the exact auditor wording Hightower expects (they sometimes want vendor name + scope + CVE scan window). paste their ask here.
ciso@hightower: Thanks — we need: 1) SOC2 report excerpt (security controls, last audit date) 2) pen-test letter stating scope (external infra + app) and signatory name + role 3) network topology diagram showing isolation for POC. Also need a statement re: KMS separation (do you support separate customer KMS keys for logs/keys in the POC?). If possible, zip + presigned link is fine.
ellie (SalesOps): noted. I'll queue a dedicated quote and mark whether KMS separation requires Private deployment (it does for customer-managed keys). Will share pricing by EOD.
sam (Support): command I used to generate presigned: ```bash
rwd-cli presign create --bundle rwd-evidence-17645.zip --ttl 7d
# returns: https://dataroom.internal/presign/rwd-evidence-17645.zip
```
raj (SalesEng): for the network diagram we can provide a redacted variant for public POC and a full diagram for NDA/dataroom. Marta — can you sign the attestation template once we have final wording?
marta (Security): yes, I can sign once wording is agreed and legal approves. prefer delegated signer: Head of Security. :white_check_mark:
amaia (AE): i'll coordinate with Hightower for final wording and confirm signer name by tomorrow morning. please flag blockers.
dataroom-bot: Uploaded: rwd-evidence-17645.zip (SOC2_excerpt.pdf, iso-summary.pdf, pen-test-template.pdf, redacted-topology.png).
